correctness.rationale: Leibniz on degree-three relations forces D(x),D(y) to have no scalar parts, leaving twelve free coefficients. On radical V⊕W (W=V⊗V), D has block [A,0;B,A⊗I+I⊗A], with A arbitrary 2×2 and B arbitrary 4×2. Stratifying A by rank, nilpotence, trace and characteristic gives each Kronecker-sum rank. The total D rank equals rank A + rank L_A + induced rank from ker A into W/im L_A, counted by Gaussian binomial maps and lifts. This reconstructs both q-polynomials and H_q(1)=q^12. Independently exhaustively enumerated all 2^12 parameters over F2 via a separately written six-dimensional matrix-rank calculation and confirmed 1,45,466,576,3008; independently evaluated q=3 formulas and checked sum 3^12.
residual_risks: Characteristic-two ceiling follows tensor Kronecker-sum degeneracy, not experimental timeout; arbitrary prime powers handled via rank-preserving scalar extension and q-formulas.
